title: ESC-03 stoppage and lockout, Friday 18 September 2026 (evening peak)

sources.time_basis: observed_at and ingested_at in UTC (ISO 8601, Z). Gateway clock is NTP-synchronised.
sources.cadence: One sample per point every 60 s at the minute mark; gearbox vibration is the RMS over the preceding minute. Uploaded in 5-minute batches.

points.origin: gateway CT on motor cable, inverter output side
gateway 3D people counter above upper landing

points.sampling: RMS velocity over the preceding minute

points.origin: gateway, line to line at controller isolator

known_issues: Gap 2026-09-17T01:06Z to 01:24Z: gateway restarted for a scheduled firmware update; the unsent buffer was discarded.
Gap 2026-09-18T17:20Z to 17:59Z: gateway diagnostics report no cellular registration from 17:21:07Z, then a restart at 17:59:20Z after a supply interruption. The unsent buffer was discarded.
Batch 2026-09-16T10:55Z to 11:00Z was uploaded twice (second copy at 11:21:14Z). Duplicate reading_id values are present.
People counter accuracy degrades in dense crowds; values of 80 persons/min or more are flagged low_confidence and may undercount.
Handrail percentages are not applicable when the step band is not running (empty value, quality not_applicable).

sources.time_basis: controller_time is the controller's local clock with no timezone stored. The clock is set manually and is not NTP-synchronised; when it was last set is unknown.
sources.capacity: Newest 64 events; older events are overwritten. event_no is the controller's running counter.
known_issues: Events in the same second are listed in the order the controller recorded them.
The vendor manual and full code descriptions are not included; the text column is the controller's own short text.

sources.system: CMMS work order WO-55218, contractor service report attachment
sources.time_basis: Local site time; dates written dd/mm/yyyy.
known_issues: Contractor's own checklist; items not on the checklist may not be recorded.

sources.interface: Typed from the technician's notebook after the visit
known_issues: Written after the event from notes; times are approximate.

requested_not_received: Station incident report for the passenger near-fall, and CCTV of the upper and lower landings (requested 2026-09-19 08:10 local).
